svg.title: Smart Tutor on-premise at a glance
svg.desc: The learner's browser reaches one EC2 virtual machine in our own AWS account, which runs every Smart Tutor service with Docker Compose and still uses six managed AWS services: the documents bucket, the ingest queue, Bedrock models, settings and secrets, the image registry, and monitoring.
